source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 22 May 1952, p. 5 ("Labour gains two seats at Newtownards"); Irish News, 22 May 1952, p. 7 ("Newtownards")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: read on the block images of the News-Letter (22 May 1952, p. 5, article BNL19520522.2.142) and the Irish News (22 May 1952, p. 7, article INW19520522.2.148)

note: Election of councillors for the four wards and of the four aldermen of Newtownards Borough Council, polled 21 May 1952. Labour gained two seats from the Unionists. Three Unionist aldermen were returned unopposed (J. M. Poots, S. J. McWatters, H. M. Donaldson; Irish News, 22 May 1952) without their wards being printed: McWatters is filed under Victoria Ward from the 1946 return; Poots and Donaldson held no aldermanship in 1946, so their wards (Castle and Glen) cannot be fixed and those two aldermanships are not recorded. The Scrabo Ward aldermanship is not recorded either: the News-Letter prints Isaac Baxter (Ind.) 885 with no opponent, the Irish News J. Baxter (Ind.) 835 against R. B. McGimpsey 312, and no majority, total or turnout is printed to settle the figure. The Irish News prints H. McGimpsey's figure as 373 and the third name as 'Miss G. Fowles'; the News-Letter figure (378) is kept. Neither changes the result.
